$schema.description: JSON Schema URL, used by editors for autocomplete and validation.

sourceRoots.description: Canonical project-relative files or folders that define the complete static analysis universe.

ignoredPaths.description: Canonical project-relative files or folders explicitly excluded from the analysis universe.

paths.description: Canonical project-relative paths belonging to this Layer. No declared Layer scopes may overlap, within one Layer or across Layers.

additionalProperties.title: Layer
additionalProperties.description: A named, configured group of project-relative paths.

layers.description: Every Layer in the project, keyed by id.

rules.description: Maps a Layer id to the Layer ids it may directly depend on. Rules are default-deny and transitive: a dependency between two Layers with no declared path between them, direct or transitive, is a violation. A Layer with no outgoing rule is a valid, intentional leaf.

additionalProperties.title: LayerGraph
additionalProperties.description: A named set of Rules representing one responsibility (e.g. core architecture, test boundaries). This is an organizational grouping, not an enforcement boundary — enforcement unions every Rule declared across every LayerGraph in the project.

layerGraphs.description: Every LayerGraph in the project, keyed by id. An empty set denies every cross-Layer dependency.

title: Laymos Config
description: Declares a project's Layers and LayerGraphs.
